newsitem.title: USA: Targeted Genetics starts Phase II trial.
newsitem.headline: Targeted Genetics starts Phase II trial.

text.p: Targeted Genetics Corp on Tuesday said it has begun a Phase II clinical trial of Targeted Genetics' cystic fibrosis gene therapy product, tgAAV-CFTR, with Stanford Medical Center.

The Phase II trial will test the safety and efficacy of tgAAV-CFTR in helping prevent sinusitis in patients with cystic fibrosis. Targeted Genetics was granted orphan drug status for tgAAV-CFTR in March 1995.
Recent Phase I clinical trials showed tgAAVCFTR is safe and provides efficient gene transfer and long-term gene persistence (up to 70 days).
